errors.evidence: The starting value in 2006 is visibly higher than 2.0%, at approximately 2.5%.
The peak value in 2008 is significantly higher than 5.0%, it is approximately 5.7%.
The value in 2012 is a local peak at approximately 2.6%, not 2.0%.
The value in 2013 is approximately 1.8%, not 1.0%.
The value in 2019 is approximately 1.6%, not 2.0%.

The description completely omits several key features of the data trend, including the sharp drop after 2008 to below 1%, and the period of negative values, reaching a minimum of approximately -0.5% in 2015. This makes the summary of the trend highly misleading.
